interactions.summary: Asked for any final note, Jiang closes with a brief warning to stay safe because the coming period will be hard.
The host signs off, promotes engagement and subscriptions, and notes that paid supporters can submit questions and guest suggestions.

speaker_notes.note: The final 'Bye' is labeled UNKNOWN and is too short to attribute confidently.

claims.claim: Jiang's final advice is that the coming period will be tough and people should stay safe.
The host says paying supporters can ask guest questions and make guest recommendations in future episodes.

signature_moments.moment: After all the forecasts, Jiang's final compression is starkly personal: be safe, because it is going to be tough.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It captures the emotional register of the interview's ending and the practical tone Jiang wants to leave with listeners.

chronology_notes.note: The interview closes on 2025-09-18 with Jiang collapsing his broader geopolitical forecast into a direct warning about near-future difficulty.
